# What does a state draw, and which selector shows it?

Read this when your own markup shows a state, such as hover, focus, selection, a disabled control or an invalid field.

**The roles below answer the states of a control, and the second table says which attribute or pseudo-class shows each one.** `--fill-hover` covers a cell as well as a row. Focus and selection reach utilities through `ring-edge-focus`, `outline-edge-focus` and `bg-selected`, and the widths, the gap and the disabled fade through the arbitrary forms named in each row.

<!-- @tree GENERATED by bun run generate:token-tree. Edit that script, not this copy. -->

Your markup and Arena's components both read the roles on this page. A role keeps its name until a major release, and its value is the style plugin's to change in any release.

| role | question | utility | combines with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bw-focus` | How wide is the ring a control draws while it holds keyboard focus? | none | none |
| `--edge-focus` | What colour is the ring a control draws while it holds keyboard focus? | `ring-edge-focus`, `outline-edge-focus` | none |
| `--edge-invalid` | What colour is the edge of a field that holds an invalid value? | `border-edge-invalid` | none |
| `--edge-selected` | What colour is the edge that marks a selected or current item? | `border-edge-selected` | none |
| `--edge-tab-selected` | What colour is the rule that marks the selected tab? | `border-edge-tab-selected` | none |
| `--fade-disabled` | What share of its opacity does a disabled control keep? | none | none |
| `--fill-hover` | What colour does a table row, link card or navigation row take under the pointer? | `bg-hover` | none |
| `--fill-selected` | What colour washes the background of a selected or current item? | `bg-selected` | `bg-selected/(--level-accent-soft-primary)` |
| `--gap-focus` | How far is the keyboard focus ring from the edge of its control? | none | none |
| `--ink-invalid` | What colour is the error text of a field that holds an invalid value? | `text-ink-invalid` | none |
| `--ink-selected` | What colour is the text of a selected or current item? | `text-ink-selected` | none |

| attribute | selector | roles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hover` | `:hover` | `--fill-hover` |
| `focus-visible` | `:focus-visible` | `--bw-focus`, `--edge-focus`, `--gap-focus` |
| `aria-selected` | `[aria-selected="true"]` | `--edge-selected`, `--edge-tab-selected`, `--fill-selected`, `--ink-selected` |
| `aria-current` | `[aria-current]:not([aria-current="false"])` | `--edge-selected`, `--fill-selected`, `--ink-selected` |
| `aria-pressed` | `[aria-pressed="true"]` | `--edge-selected`, `--fill-selected`, `--ink-selected` |
| `aria-disabled` | `[aria-disabled="true"]` | `--fade-disabled` |
| `disabled` | `:disabled` | `--fade-disabled` |
| `aria-invalid` | `[aria-invalid="true"]` | `--edge-invalid`, `--ink-invalid` |
